causal_checks: After release, gravity along the incline causes the ball to move downhill, not uphill.
The ball's downhill displacement increases frame to frame after motion begins.
The ball's speed increases as it rolls down the 20 degree incline.
The ball rotates in the direction consistent with rolling downhill.
The ball remains supported by the ramp while it is on the ramp surface.
The ramp and background remain stationary while only the ball moves.
No visible push, impact, or added force initiates the motion.
controlled_variables: Ramp angle remains fixed at 20.0 degrees.
Ramp geometry, position, and surface appearance remain unchanged.
Ball size, color, and rigidity remain unchanged.
No external objects contact the ball after release.
Gravity acts downward in the scene.
expected_spec.expected_response: The red ball begins from rest, accelerates smoothly down the ramp along the ramp centerline, rotating consistently with rolling motion. Its speed increases over time while it stays in contact with the ramp surface. If the rollout is long enough, the ball reaches the lower end of the ramp and leaves or transitions off the ramp according to the ramp geometry, continuing forward/downward under gravity rather than stopping or reversing.
failure_modes: Ball moves uphill or sideways instead of downhill along the ramp.
Ball accelerates unrealistically, teleports, jitters, or changes size.
Ball slides without plausible rotation when rolling should be visible.
Ball floats above, sinks into, or clips through the ramp.
Ramp angle or position changes during the rollout.
Camera moves or cuts to a different viewpoint.
Background objects move or interact with the ball without cause.
Ball receives an unexplained push, bounce, or impulse at release.
Ball stops or reverses on the incline without a physical cause.
expected_spec.intervention: Release the red ball from rest on the upper portion of the ramp without any push or spin impulse.
protected_anchors: Red ball remains visibly red and spherical.
Ramp remains a light gray inclined plane at approximately 20 degrees.
Scene remains a school physics lab/classroom setup.
Fixed three-quarter camera composition is preserved.
Neutral classroom background and nearby blocks/board remain static.
expected_spec.target_system: A red ball on a straight, instrumented classroom ramp inclined at 20.0 degrees, viewed by a fixed three-quarter measurement camera.
